metadata.description: Jody's portable pro dev skill stack

plugins.name: pro-core
plugins.description: Universal base skills and guardrails: find-skills, karpathy-guidelines, grill-me interview/stress-test helper. /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve). PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash). SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch.

plugins.name: pro-execution
plugins.description: Execution discipline skills: TDD, systematic debugging, git worktrees, and subagent-driven development. Depends on pro-core for universal guardrails and repo safety.

plugins.name: pro-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion. Depends on Playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js stack marker with official Vercel and Figma plugin dependencies

plugins.name: pro-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skills: design tokens, accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 POUR), motion system, typography scale, shadcn/ui composition. Depends on Figma from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-testing
plugins.description: The Verify phase: Vitest, agent-browser (interactive verification), Storybook interactions, plus a vendored qa-skills library (43 skills) exposed as a curated testing-core subset — qa-do/qa-start routers, playwright-automation, visual-testing, api/contract-testing, test-reliability, and QA strategy/risk/planning. Depends on Playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-data
plugins.description: Data & auth skills: Drizzle ORM (architecture + schema), Prisma schema patterns, NextAuth/Auth.js patterns

plugins.name: pro-spdd
plugins.description: Structured Prompt-Driven Development workflow: story decomposition, analysis, REASONS Canvas, generation, prompt update, sync, API test, code review, and reverse engineering. Includes openspdd-ts CLI (bin/openspdd.mjs) for installing templates into any AI editor. Depends on pro-execution for disciplined implementation workflows. Adapted from gszhangwei/open-spdd.

plugins.name: pro-pdd
plugins.description: Opt-in plan-driven development skills: brainstorming and written implementation plans. Depends on pro-execution for worktree and subagent execution handoff.

plugins.name: pro-gstack
plugins.description: Opt-in GStack workflow adapters: persona-driven planning, review, QA, shipping, browser, security, documentation, and memory workflows. Adapted from garrytan/gstack.

plugins.name: pro-research
plugins.description: Deep web research engine for any topic. /research <question> runs an adaptive intake interview, then decomposes into angles, fans out research subagents over a free-first retrieval ladder (Serper -> Jina/Firecrawl -> agent-browser), verifies citations, and synthesizes a cited report. /lead-research <company|domain|ICP> is the lead/account specialization: same engine plus ICP scoring and cited lead profiles. Domain memory + evidence persisted to .research/ to survive compaction. Optional Mieruka governance mirror when .mieruka/ is present.

plugins.name: pro-mieruka
plugins.description: Mieruka integration: /init-mieruka installs mieruka into the current project, /start-mieruka launches the dev server. Resolves local build until mieruka is published to npm.

plugins.name: pro-starter
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs Jody's default pro dev stack (core, execution, quality, design, testing, data, nextjs marker, and mieruka)
